limitations: C512/M32 candidate includes two I16 down matrices versus original FP16 down; local normalization replay does not qualify whole-model semantics.
Both system prefix preparation and dynamic M32 blocks use candidate; every measured call resets/prepares system only; same counts do not imply same KV values.
True M8 tail uses original graph, so candidate/original precision mixed at final8 rows by design.
Performance has3 scenes percell once, not repeated trials; P95 has low statistical support. Fixed32feedback is speed/parity diagnostic, not natural generation quality.
Natural48 includes former new-frozen-household-v2 already used in earlier model experiments; this run is regression, not a fresh heldout set.
Performance requests use frozen text input, not current ASR output; audio residency/concurrency does not make this end-to-end ASR-to-action latency.
Natural RAG top3 must be checked for mutually conflicting/negated directions; candidates are not executed and no motors enabled.
No image encoder/live microphone; full dynamic64–256/batch-boundary100ms acceptance remains pending; boundary20 are not run.
